The six GLB files in this folder and the sample model in src/sample.js are 3D models created by
Georgios Korakakis in Autodesk 3ds Max (Autodesk Education licence) for an interactive EPUB on
sp hybridisation. They are exported as authored, before accessibility remediation, and are used
here as test fixtures.
